2.7 Java Packages vs. C++ namespaces
Java organizes its classes into packages (and sub packages). Similarly, C++ organizes its classes into
namespaces. For instance, Code 9 shows how to declare a class inside a namespace and the following
code snippet shows an example of variable declaration:
#include "Car.h"
using namespace gvsu;
int main() {
Car red_kia ("1G97192731232");
gvsu::Car blue_chevy ("1GDSTDY231233"); // alternate syntax
}
